shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.html:
At Peptiva, we strive to ensure your order is processed quickly and delivered reliably.

Shipping Options & Estimated Delivery

We offer both Standard and Expedited shipping options at checkout.

Shipping Rates

return-refund.title: Return & Refund Policy
return-refund.html:
At Peptiva, the integrity, safety, and purity of our products are our top priorities. Every product we ship is verified to exceed 99% purity, and we stand behind that commitment. As all of our compounds are intended strictly for research use only and are highly sensitive in nature, we maintain a limited return and refund policy.

99% Purity Money-Back Guarantee

We are confident in the quality of every product we sell. If you obtain a valid, third-party Certificate of Analysis (COA) test on any Peptiva Supplies product and the results show purity below 99%, we will issue a full refund for that product.

To submit a purity claim:

  • Email us at support@peptivasupplies.com within 30 days of delivery.
  • Include a copy of the third-party COA test results clearly showing the product name, batch or lot number, and purity reading below 99%.
  • Our team will review the submitted documentation and respond within 3–5 business days.

General Return & Refund Policy

Outside of our Purity Guarantee, all sales are final. We do not offer refunds or accept returns for ordering errors, change of mind, or misuse. This policy helps us maintain quality control and ensures that all customers receive products that meet our rigorous standards.

If your order arrives damaged, defective, or you receive the wrong item, you must notify us within 48 hours of delivery at support@peptivasupplies.com. Please include a detailed description and clear photos of the issue. Our support team will review your case and determine eligibility for a replacement.

Refunds will only be considered in rare cases where:

  • The product fails to meet 99% purity as verified by a valid third-party COA test.
  • The order was never delivered due to an error on our part.
  • A replacement is not possible and the issue was reported within the required timeframe.

We do not refund or replace items that have been opened, used, or returned without prior authorization (with the exception of products submitted for third-party purity testing under our Purity Guarantee).

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:

Data Security

Peptiva implements strong technical and organizational safeguards to protect your information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

faq.a: Peptides are short chains of amino acids linked by peptide bonds. They are smaller than proteins and serve as important research tools for studying biological processes, protein interactions, and cellular mechanisms. These materials are designated for Research Use Only and are typically used in preclinical experiments, academic studies, or product development testing.
Our products are available to research institutions, academic laboratories, and authorized professionals. All purchases are subject to verification of research or professional credentials.

faq.q: Are your Peptides intended for human use?
faq.a: No. All Peptiva products are designated exclusively for laboratory research purposes. They are intended for use by qualified professionals in controlled research environments. Research Use Only.

faq.q: What purity levels do you guarantee?
faq.a: All our peptides are manufactured to a minimum purity of 99%. Each product is tested using HPLC and Mass Spectrometry, with results documented in the Certificate of Analysis.
Yes. We use independent laboratories to verify our quality claims, ensuring unbiased confirmation of purity and identity for complete transparency.

faq.q: How do you ship temperature-sensitive Peptides?
faq.a: We use appropriate cold packs and insulated packaging for temperature-sensitive products. This cold chain approach ensures stability from our facility to your laboratory.
Standard shipping typically takes 2-4 business days within the U.S.

faq.q: How should I store my Peptides?
faq.a: Most peptide products should be stored at -20°C for long-term stability prior to laboratory use. Once reconstituted for assay preparation, samples should be stored at 4°C and used within the timeframe specified in the accompanying Certificate of Analysis to preserve sample integrity for research purposes. Always protect from light and moisture.

Due to the nature of research materials, all sales are final, and we cannot accept returns for change of mind or ordering errors. However, we stand behind our quality with a 99% Purity Money-Back Guarantee. Purity Issues: If valid third-party testing shows a product is under 99% purity, we will issue a full refund (subject to review). Damaged/Incorrect Items: Please contact us at support@Peptiva.com within 48 hours of delivery. For full details on how to submit a purity claim, please visit our Return & Refund Policy.
